message: The other night, we had a little kitchen mishap while I was making dinner. Smoke filled the air, and before I could even grab the fire extinguisher, my family was lighting up the group chat with jokes and reminders about our escape plan. It turned into a bit of a comedy show, but it reminded me how important it is to keep those safety plans fresh and fun. Who else has a family chat that gets a little wild when things heat up?
